ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low macro-level ratio of high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (black) pixels, with approximately 20% white pixel coverage occurring in concentrated clusters against a 80% dominant dark field.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant low-intensity contiguous field; high-contrast white geometric blobs and linear streaks are concentrated heavily on the distal tips and along the lower medial regions, with high-frequency punctate white pixels scattered across the central lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped depression with a visible interior angle of approximately 65 degrees and a moderate bounding-box depth relative to lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude irregularities and serrations visible along the entire trailing edge boundary, isolated against the lighter water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave mathematical curve fitted to the trailing edges of both lobes, terminating in acute, upward-tapering distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Extensive spatial detection of circular high-contrast pixel clusters (barnacle scars and active colonization) concentrated on the extreme left and right distal tips and trailing edges.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous distinct white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) visible; notable parallel groupings on the left lobe and vertical/diagonal unaligned scratches on the right lobe medial to the tip.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive rake marks across both lobes and significant calcified accumulations (barnacles) on the outermost tips causing high-contrast texture anomalies.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a distinctive 'salt-and-pepper' high-intensity pixel spray across the central lower fluke surface where the tail stock meets the fluke lobes.
